grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: The School Garden Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟教育材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
The School Garden Project

Last year, the students at Green Valley School started a garden project. The idea came from a science teacher, Ms. Chen. She wanted students to learn about plants and healthy food. At first, only ten students joined. They met after school on Fridays. They planted tomatoes, beans, and sunflowers.

Since last September, the garden has changed a lot. The students have already built four small wooden boxes for the plants. They have also painted a sign that says "Green Valley Garden." The school has given them some money for seeds and tools. However, the students have not bought new gloves yet. They are still using old gloves from the art room.

Ms. Chen has taught at the school for five years. She says, "I have never seen students so excited about vegetables!" The garden project has been a big success. Last month, the students picked their first tomatoes. They sold them at a small market and made 200 yuan. They have not decided how to spend the money yet.

The garden has also helped the students make new friends. Li Wei, a student in Grade 8, joined the project in October. He says, "I have learned how to grow plants. Before, I didn't know anything about gardening." Now, twenty-five students are in the garden club. They meet every Friday afternoon. The school plans to start a second garden next year.

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或者从过去开始持续到现在的动作。结构是 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还（没）”。since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段。一般过去时只表示过去某个时间发生的动作，与现在无关。例如：I have already finished my homework.（现在完成时，强调现在作业完成了）I finished my homework yesterday.（一般过去时，只说明昨天做了作业）。
grammar.example: The students have already built four small wooden boxes for the plants.

questions.explanation: already 常与现在完成时连用，主语 She 是第三人称单数，用 has finished。

questions.prompt: They ______ to the new museum yet.
questions.explanation: yet 用于否定句，表示“还没有”，现在完成时结构为 haven't been。
since 后接时间点（2010），表示从那时起一直到现在。

questions.prompt: He has worked in this company ______ ten years.
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段（ten years），表示持续了十年。
